title: BBC Sci-Fi Radio Plays
identity_notes: Curated audio-drama compilation rather than one continuous historical BBC series. The 43 frozen objects mix standalone radio plays, serialized parts, compiled serials and a 14-track 2016 Audible drama. Chronology, broadcaster and creative credits are therefore item-specific.

historical_context.title: BBC tradition of literary science-fiction adaptation
historical_context.description: The collection includes documented BBC adaptations of major prose/film works across multiple decades, including The Caves of Steel, Bond novels and modern Bafflegab productions.

historical_context.title: Mixed-provenance digital archive
historical_context.description: One modern library container combines unrelated BBC productions and at least one non-BBC Audible production; item-level provenance is therefore essential.

historical_context.title: Radio drama into podcast and digital-audio distribution
historical_context.description: The collection spans broadcast radio, BBC Sounds/podcast-style serial releases and commercial full-cast digital audio drama.
